```{r}
# Function to flag reverters based on a set of columns and reversion pattern
flag_reverters <- function(df, cols, from_val, to_val) {
  df %>%
    select(hhidpn, all_of(cols)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(has_revert = {
      vals <- c_across(all_of(cols))
      any(sapply(which(vals == from_val), function(i) any(vals[(i+1):length(vals)] == to_val, na.rm = TRUE)))
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(has_revert) %>%
    pull(hhidpn)
}
```


```{r}
# ---- Langa-Weir: dementia subset + reverters ----
# Define reverters as anyone with dementia→normal, dementia→CIND, or CIND→normal
langa_reverter_ids <- unique(c(
  flag_reverters(dt_analysis_age70_langa_dementia, dem_3lw_cols, 3, 1), # dem -> normal
  flag_reverters(dt_analysis_age70_langa_dementia, dem_3lw_cols, 3, 2) # dem -> CIND
))

dt_langa_dem_revert <- dt_analysis_age70_langa_dementia %>%
  filter(hhidpn %in% langa_reverter_ids)

#304
```


```{r}
# Dementia -> Normal
ids_dem_to_normal <- flag_reverters(dt_analysis_age70_langa_dementia, dem_3lw_cols, 3, 1)
length(ids_dem_to_normal)

# Dementia -> CIND
ids_dem_to_cind <- flag_reverters(dt_analysis_age70_langa_dementia, dem_3lw_cols, 3, 2)
length(ids_dem_to_cind)

length(unique(c(ids_dem_to_normal, ids_dem_to_cind)))
```


```{r}
# Langa 3-cat seq plot (dementia + reverters)
cog_seq_langa <- dt_langa_dem_revert %>%
  select(hhidpn, all_of(dem_3lw_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("dem"), ~ case_when(
    . == 1 ~ "Normal",
    . == 2 ~ "CIND",
    . == 3 ~ "Dementia",
    TRUE   ~ "Missing"
  )))

seq_data_langa <- cog_seq_langa %>%
  select(-hhidpn)

colnames(seq_data_langa) <- c(
  "2010", "2012", "2014", "2016", "2018", "2020"
)

seq_def_langa <- seqdef(seq_data_langa)

colors <- c(
  "Normal"   = "lightyellow",
  "CIND"     = "#FFD580",
  "Dementia" = "#FFA07A",
  "Missing"  = "gray"
)

state_order <- attr(seq_def_langa, "alphabet")
cpal_ordered <- colors[state_order]

file_path <- "anonymized

png(
  file_path,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(3, 1))

# Main plot: increase font sizes and left margin
par(
  mar = c(5, 7, 4, 2) + 0.1,
  cex.main = 1.1,
  cex.lab = 2
)

seqIplot(
  seq_def_langa,
  sortv = "from.start",
  with.legend = FALSE,
  ylab = "Individuals (N = 304)",
  xlab = "Year",
  las = 1,
  yaxt = "n",
  cex.axis = 1.5,
  cpal = cpal_ordered
)

# Legend: reset margins
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()

legend_order <- c("Normal", "CIND", "Dementia", "Missing")

legend(
  "center",
  legend = legend_order,
  fill = colors[legend_order],
  cex = 1.5,
  bty = "o",
  box.lwd = 1,
  bg = "white"
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Prepare binary sequence objects
# ============================================================

make_seq_2cat <- function(data, cols) {

  seq_data <- data %>%
    select(all_of(cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ case_when(
      . == 0 ~ "No dementia",
      . == 1 ~ "Dementia",
      TRUE   ~ "Missing"
    )))

  colnames(seq_data) <- sub(".*([0-9]{4})$", "\\1", cols)

  seqdef(seq_data)
}

seq_langa_fig4 <- make_seq_2cat(
  dt_langa_dem_revert_2cat,
  dem_cols
)

seq_dp_fig4 <- make_seq_2cat(
  dt_dp_dem_revert,
  dem_cols
)

seq_hudomiet_fig4 <- make_seq_2cat(
  dt_hudomiet_dem_revert_2cat,
  c("dem2010", "dem2012", "dem2014", "dem2016")
)

seq_wu_fig4 <- make_seq_2cat(
  dt_memimp_dem_revert,
  dem_cols
)

colors_2cat <- c(
  "No dementia" = "#F0E68C",
  "Dementia"    = "#FFA07A",
  "Missing"     = "gray"
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Function to draw one panel
# ============================================================

draw_panel <- function(seq_object, panel_title) {

  par(
    mar = c(3.5, 4.2, 2.5, 0.8),
    mgp = c(2.3, 0.7, 0),
    cex = 1,
    cex.lab = 1.1,
    cex.main = 1.1
  )

  seqIplot(
    seq_object,
    sortv = "from.start",
    main = panel_title,
    with.legend = FALSE,
    use.layout = FALSE,
    ylab = "",
    xlab = "Year",
    las = 1,
    yaxt = "n",
    cex.axis = 1,
    cpal = unname(
      colors_2cat[attr(seq_object, "alphabet")]
    )
  )

  mtext(
    text = paste0("Individuals (N = ", nrow(seq_object), ")"),
    side = 2,
    line = 0.8,
    las = 0,
    cex = 1.1
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Combine four panels with one bottom legend
# ============================================================

draw_figure4 <- function() {

  layout(
    matrix(
      c(
        1, 2,
        3, 4,
        5, 5
      ),
      nrow = 3,
      byrow = TRUE
    ),
    widths = c(1, 1),
    heights = c(1, 1, 0.18)
  )

  par(
    cex = 1,
    mex = 1,
    oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

draw_panel(seq_langa_fig4, "A. Langa-Weir")
draw_panel(seq_hudomiet_fig4, "B. Hudomiet")
draw_panel(seq_dp_fig4, "C. Expert")
draw_panel(seq_wu_fig4, "D. Wu")

  # Shared legend
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), cex = 1)
  plot.new()

  legend(
    "center",
    legend = names(colors_2cat),
    fill = unname(colors_2cat),
    horiz = TRUE,
    cex = 1,
    bty = "n"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 4. Export at final size: 9 × 7 inches
# ============================================================

output_dir <- paste0(
  "anonymized",
  "R00/Manuscripts/HRS/Dementia algorithms/Output"
)

# PDF
pdf(
  file = file.path(output_dir, "Figure4_reverters_combined.pdf"),
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  pointsize = 10,
  family = "Helvetica",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

draw_figure4()
dev.off()

# PNG
png(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure4_reverters_combined.png"),
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  pointsize = 10
)

draw_figure4()
dev.off()
```
